items.title: How a conversion is attributed
steps: The user clicks or views it
The click or view is logged
The sale is matched to the earlier ad
Credit is given by the attribution model
items.why: Exposure is logged first, then matched to the sale, then credit is shared.

items.title: How an incrementality test runs
steps: Split people into test and holdout groups
Show ads to the test group only
Report the extra effect of the ads
items.why: The holdout group shows what would have happened anyway.
